keepalive-configuration.usage: KeepaliveConfiguration as JSON object, @file, or - for stdin. Members are inherited one by one from the instance value, then the tool's current value, then the platform default; the CLI applies no default. Omit the flag to send nothing, or pass {} to send an empty override.
fields: KeepaliveMode: NONE, REQUEST, CONNECTION or MIXED
KeepaliveTimeout: integer seconds with a unit, from 300s to 1800s, for example 600s, 5m or 30m
values: REQUEST: renew while requests are being served
CONNECTION: renew while a connection stays open
MIXED: renew on requests and connections
examples: agr tool create -n my-tool -t code-interpreter --network-configuration '{"NetworkMode":"SANDBOX"}' --keepalive-configuration '{"KeepaliveMode":"REQUEST","KeepaliveTimeout":"600s"}' --auto-pause --auto-resume -o json

auto-pause.usage: Choose whether instances pause (true) or stop (false) at expiry. Omit the flag to use the service default. --auto-pause=false sends an explicit false.

auto-resume.usage: Automatically resume paused instances on data-plane access. Omit the flag to use the service default. --auto-resume=false sends an explicit false.

examples: agr tool create -n my-tool -t code-interpreter --network-configuration '{"NetworkMode":"SANDBOX"}' --log-configuration '{"CLSConfig":{"TopicId":"xxxxx-xxxx-xxxx"}}'

log-configuration.usage: LogConfiguration JSON object, @file, or - for stdin
examples: agr tool create -n logs-tool -t custom --network-configuration '{"NetworkMode":"PUBLIC"}' --custom-configuration '{"Image":"<registry>/<image>:<tag>","ImageRegistryType":"personal","Command":["<entrypoint>"]}' --role-arn '<role-arn>' --log-configuration '{"CLSConfig":{"TopicId":"<cls-topic-id>"},"ContentFormat":"auto"}' -o text
fields: ContentFormat: raw keeps the original text; auto extracts the first JSON object level or a complete logfmt line and falls back to the whole entry in content when it cannot extract it fully. Values are case-insensitive and normalized to lower case by the server; omitting it or sending an empty string keeps raw. auto requires a valid CLSConfig.TopicId. CLSConfig is only accepted on --tool-type custom tools, and that custom configuration must name its start command; the service requires --role-arn and a network mode with egress for CLS logging. Log body processing happens on the server; the CLI does not parse logs.
values: raw: keep the log line exactly as written
auto: extract structured fields when the server can do so completely
